notes: Two separate groups is correct, so I kept it. The booklet builds two separate models: the Light Repair Truck (steps 1-26) and a street light with traffic light (steps 27-31, its own steps 1-5). They are never joined, and the last page shows them standing next to each other. The street light is placed at x=20 only to keep it off the truck.
Step numbers follow the booklet's large step numbers: truck steps 1-26 and the street light steps 27-31. Sub-steps inside a numbered step share that number. The minifigure page has no number.
The minifigure parts are not in the piece list. The wrench p43 is held by the minifigure, so it has no grid position and is given step 26.

Steps 2-3 build the chassis upside down. The black and orange plates clutch the underside of the base ends, and the wheel holders p74 and p75 clutch the underside of those plates. The plates are added before the holders, so the holders cannot be listed under rests_on. They have no grid position and are linked through other_joins.

Positions are approximate. The front of the truck is at x=0 and the rear at about x=15. The base p55 has its bottom at layer 2. The roof wedge p49 sits on the windscreen at layer 13. Some rests_on entries are inferred from the pictures.
The rear orange inverted slopes p32 and p33 sit beside the grey brick and the 2x2 slope and have no brick under them. They are linked by other_joins.
Assumptions: the door hinges sit on the clip plates p69 and p70, and the hammer p48 clips onto p70. The round plate p68 sits on the turntable, and the crane arm is mounted on the blue pin p78.
The stickers p3 are applied to the front bumper piece (step 13) and the roof wedge (step 20). Both are recorded as joins, and the sheet has no position.
